ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $\angle ABC=30^\circ$, and D is the midpoint of AC, then what is the value of $\tan \angle DBC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, and $\angle ABC=30^\circ$,\\
hence $\tan\angle ABC=\frac{AC}{BC}=\tan30^\circ=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$. If we let $AC=\sqrt{3}a$, then $BC=3a$,\\
since D is the midpoint of AC,\\
thus $DC=\frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}a$,\\
therefore $\tan\angle DBC=\frac{DC}{BC}=\frac{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}a}{3a}=\boxed{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6}}$.
